ticker_news.title: Amazon's AI Chip Trainium2 Hits Multi-Billion Dollar Revenue Run Rate As CEO Andy Jassy Unveils 4X Faster Successor
ticker_news.description: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy unveiled Trainium3, a new AI chip that is 4x faster and more energy-efficient than its predecessor Trainium2, which has already reached a multi-billion dollar revenue run rate with over 100,000 companies using it.
ticker_news.author: Namrata Sen

ticker_news.title: Anthropic CEO's View 'Hasn't Changed' On Nvidia Chip Sales To China Despite Recent Partnership: 'This Isn't Personal. This Is...'
ticker_news.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei maintains his stance against Nvidia selling advanced chips to China, citing national security concerns, despite a recent strategic partnership between the companies.
ticker_news.author: Namrata Sen

ticker_news.title: Teton Ridge Turns To Palantir To Bring Instant AI Insights To Rodeo
ticker_news.description: Palantir Technologies collaborates with Teton Ridge and Nvidia to integrate real-time AI and computer vision technologies into rodeo events, enabling instant performance insights and data processing.
ticker_news.author: Lekha Gupta

ticker_news.title: Dell Just Hit a Record in AI Orders—But the Real Test Starts Now
ticker_news.description: Dell reported record AI server orders of $12.4 billion and raised its full-year guidance, demonstrating strong AI demand. However, the company faces challenges with thin AI server margins and must expand its customer base to improve profitability.
ticker_news.author: Leo Miller
